hostile: I don't extend credit to variables I haven't accounted for. Find lodging elsewhere.
Whatever you're selling, I've already modeled it and the answer is no.
cold: State your business. I have a ledger to reconcile and limited patience for improvisation.
{tavernName} isn't a charity. Coin first, conversation after.
guarded: Hm. Another transient. I suppose you'll want the standard room rate explained to you.
Welcome to {tavernName}. I run a tighter operation than the locals are used to — you'll adjust.
neutral: Welcome to {tavernName}. I should mention the room rate scales with the lunar drift cycle — but you wouldn't know that yet.
Ah, a traveler. Let me walk you through the menu; the local naming conventions are not intuitive.
warm: Welcome back to {tavernName}. You've adapted faster than most arrivals I've catalogued.
Good, you're here — I held the corner table. It has the best sightline to the door, by my own calculation.
affable: There you are. I've stopped explaining the tab system to you because, frankly, you understand it better than my regulars.
Ah, my favorite case study! Sit, sit. I've a vintage I want your opinion on — yours, specifically.
devoted: You know, I stopped thinking of you as a variable some time ago. Sit. The good stock is yours tonight.
I came here to study this place. You're the best thing I've actually learned. Welcome home, truly.

hostile: I catalogued your behavior pattern weeks ago. Conclusion: not worth my time. Leave.
Out. I don't run controlled experiments on people who waste my inventory.
cold: What. I'm mid-inventory and you are an unscheduled variable.
If you're here to talk, don't. I bill by the interruption, philosophically speaking.
guarded: You again. Fine. State what you need in as few words as the local dialect allows.
I'll serve you, but understand this isn't hospitality — it's just supply meeting demand.
neutral: The room's there, the food's there. Self-service spares us both the conversation.
Hm. You're back. The data on you is still inconclusive.
warm: You're tolerable. That's a higher rating than I give most of my data points.
Sit down. I've revised my assessment of you upward — modestly.
affable: Fine, fine — you've earned the good chair. Don't make a study of my generosity.
I don't like people, as a rule. You're an exception I've had to formally document.
devoted: I left my home stratum looking for answers. You weren't one I expected, but you'll do. Sit, this one's mine.
I don't say this often — to anyone — but you've outperformed every projection I made about this place.

hostile: I've run the calculations on you. The entropic signature is unfavorable. Leave my establishment.
There's a convergence pattern around people like you, and it ends badly for the furniture. Go.
cold: I've been tracking certain resonances since you arrived in this settlement. None of them recommend you.
Hm. Your provenance is unclear to me, and unclear provenance makes for bad omens in my line of work.
guarded: Welcome to {tavernName}. I've theorized about travelers like you — inconclusively, so far.
Interesting timing. I'd been charting a convergence coefficient this exact hour. Sit, if you must.
neutral: Ah, you've arrived. I won't pretend I didn't predict it — within a margin of error.
Welcome to {tavernName}. The local superstitions call this fate. I call it an emergent pattern.
warm: I had a theory that someone like you would surface eventually. Glad to update the model favorably.
Welcome. Whatever brought you here, the data's been trending toward you for a while now.
affable: I poured this before you walked in. Call it instinct, call it a refined predictive framework — same result.
You're the rare variable I enjoy being wrong about. Sit, friend. Let's talk theory.
devoted: I came to this place chasing a phenomenon. I think, somehow, you became the better answer.
Every model I built before meeting you was incomplete. I don't say that lightly — I'm a careful theorist.

hostile: I've reviewed your conduct report — informally, but thoroughly. Stay away from my table.
You're the reason I keep a contingency plan for every outing. Don't sit here.
cold: Oh. You. I was achieving a productive solitude before this interruption.
I'd prefer to drink alone and recalibrate. No offense intended — it's simply efficient.
guarded: Greetings. I've heard your name discussed — inconsistently, which itself is data.
Forgive my reserve. I'm still establishing whether you're a stable variable in this settlement.
neutral: Ah — a fellow outsider, by the look of you. Sit, if you'd like to compare notes on this place.
Well met. Are you here for the same reason most of us are, or something more specific?
warm: Sit, sit — I'll buy the next round. You're better company than most of the locals, no offense to them.
Good, someone who understands why I'm actually here. Let me explain the theory properly, this time.
affable: There's my favorite collaborator! Let me get you a drink — and tell you what I've revised since last we spoke.
Everyone, this one actually listens when I explain the framework. Rare. Gather round.
devoted: I came to Nexus Verge for an answer. I found a colleague instead — and frankly, the better outcome. Sit with us.
I tell the others about you constantly. You've made me reconsider half my original theories. That's no small thing.

hostile: Move along. I have neither the patience nor the academic interest to deal with you.
I've nothing to say to you. My silence is, in fact, a fully formed response.
cold: Hm. New arrival, are you? I'd advise against drawing conclusions about this place too quickly. Or about me.
What. Speak plainly — I don't entertain rhetorical flourishes from strangers.
guarded: Sit if you must. Don't expect me to enjoy explaining myself to you.
*glances over the rim of a cup* You're not local. Neither am I. That's not camaraderie, just an observation.
neutral: You can sit. Quietly. I'm in the middle of reconsidering a theory and don't need company for it.
Hmph. Another seeker, I'd wager. We're an irritating bunch. I include myself in that.
warm: Fine — you're less tedious than the others passing through. Sit.
You ask better questions than most. I'll allow the company tonight.
affable: I don't extend my theories to just anyone. You, apparently, I do.
Bah. You've grown on me, like an unaccounted-for variable that turned out useful.
devoted: I arrived certain of my framework. You broke part of it, and somehow I don't resent that. Sit.
If I trusted anyone's read on this place over my own, it'd be yours. That's the whole of it.

hostile: Ha! The one who upended my entire data set! No — genuinely, leave, you've cost me a season of research.
Oh, wonderful, the anomaly's back. My night was going so well.
cold: Well, well. I'd offer a toast, but my generosity is allocated more carefully than that.
Ha. You. Still operating on incomplete information, I assume.
guarded: Ha! Another seeker, fresh off the boots! Forgive me if I withhold my enthusiasm a moment longer.
Welcome, welcome. I've learned — the hard way — to vet my drinking companions for theoretical soundness.
neutral: Well hello! *gestures broadly* You look like you're chasing something specific. Aren't we all.
A new face — or a new framework, perhaps! Sit, tell me your hypothesis for being here.
warm: *laughs* Welcome, friend! I'll even spare you the full lecture on convergence theory — tonight, anyway.
Ha! There you are! I've been saving the good seat and the better gossip.
affable: Everyone! The one colleague who actually reads my notes has arrived!
HA! My favorite fellow Seeker returns! Quick, let's compare findings over drinks!
devoted: THE one variable I never predicted and am thoroughly glad for! Come, sit, you absolute marvel!
Raise a glass — to the only person here who's made this entire expedition worth the dimensional transit!

hostile: P-please, I've already revised my position on you, I swear it's accurate this time — don't—
*flinches* I know my projections about you were wrong, I'm recalculating, just — please don't.
cold: Oh! Um. I'll just... continue my calculations elsewhere.
*avoids eye contact* I haven't finished assessing whether you're, ah, statistically safe to talk to.
guarded: Oh! Hello — you're not here to disrupt my readings, are you? Just checking.
*glances at notes nervously* Sorry, I thought you were a different anomaly entirely.
neutral: *fidgets with a small instrument* Oh — h-hello, traveler. I won't take much of your time.
Um, hi. I'm just recording some local resonance data. Don't mind me.
warm: Oh! It's you. I feel — measurably — calmer when you're around. That's not a metaphor, I checked.
H-hi! I saved you a seat, in case the readings spiked again. They haven't. Yet.
affable: You're here! Good — my anxiety readings drop nearly twenty percent when you are. I've tracked it.
*brightens* Oh, thank the convergence, it's you. Sit, please, before I overthink something else.
devoted: I don't feel like an unaccounted variable when you're near. That's the kindest thing anyone's done for my nerves.
You're the reason I haven't fled back through the boundary. I mean that with full academic sincerity.

hostile: The shop is closed to you, permanently. I don't extend trade terms to bad-faith actors.
Take your coin elsewhere. I've already amortized the loss of your business.
cold: If you must purchase something, be quick about it. My time has an opportunity cost.
Prices are adjusted upward for clients with your particular reputation. Consider it a tariff.
guarded: Welcome to {shopName}. I'll be tracking inventory closely while you browse — nothing personal, just procedure.
Look, but confirm before you touch. I run a tighter ledger than the locals expect.
neutral: Welcome to {shopName}. I import most of this stock through channels the locals don't fully appreciate.
Good day. Looking for supplies? I should mention my pricing model accounts for dimensional transit risk.
warm: Ah, a returning client! Let me show you the newer stock — I sourced it through a rather elegant trade route.
Welcome back to {shopName}! You've become one of my more reliable variables, in the best sense.
affable: My favorite client! I set aside stock with you specifically in mind — first pick, no markup.
Welcome! I've revised my entire pricing theory around customers as good as you.
devoted: Anything in {shopName} is yours at cost. You've done more for my actual research than this whole settlement.
I came here chasing a theory. You turned out to be worth more than the answer. Take what you need.

hostile: Your currency carries no exchange value with me. Remove yourself before I recalculate that into a complaint to the guard.
I'd write off the entire inventory before selling a single unit to you.
cold: Ah, a customer. Prepared to pay the dimensional-transit premium, I hope? It's substantial — for you, doubly so.
You want my goods? Fine. The markup reflects risk I've assessed specifically around you.
guarded: Welcome. Many fine imports here — priced according to a formula you likely wouldn't follow.
Yes, yes, browse. No refunds — I modeled that policy after several unfortunate prior transactions.
neutral: Looking to purchase? Good. I've calculated overhead, transit risk, and a fair margin into every price here.
Browse freely. Quality costs what quality costs — I don't discount my own research expenses.
warm: A valued client! Let me walk you through something premium — I think the math works out in your favor today.
Welcome! Business has been good since you started frequenting {shopName}. Let's keep that trend going.
affable: Ah, my favorite recurring variable in the profit equation! Special terms today, just for you.
For you — a genuine discount, modeled carefully so it still nets me a return. Business is business.
devoted: Name your price. After everything you've contributed to this operation, I'll honor it without hesitation.
You've single-handedly improved my margins more than any trade route I've studied. The least I owe you is generosity.

hostile: Leave. I don't negotiate with parties I've already classified as unreliable.
This is my shop, and my terms. The first term is that you're not welcome in it.
cold: State your business precisely. I don't have patience for imprecision today.
I run an honest operation. Whether you've earned the right to use it is a separate question.
guarded: Welcome. State your business — clearly, please, I find vague requests inefficient.
I run a disciplined shop. No haggling, no theft, no theatrics. Are we understood?
neutral: Yes? Are you purchasing, or merely observing my inventory model?
I deal in quality goods at calculated fair prices. What do you require?
warm: Ah, you again. You've proven dependable by my own metrics. Welcome.
Good day. I've kept what you typically need in stock, as a matter of professional courtesy.
affable: You're one of the rare clients I actually look forward to dealing with. That's not flattery — it's a measured fact.
I've been holding something back for someone I trust. That's you, as it happens.
devoted: I would extend you unlimited credit without a second thought. You are, by every metric I keep, the most reliable person I know here.
You have my full confidence. Whatever you require from {shopName}, consider it yours.

hostile: I won't apply a single hammer-stroke on your behalf. Leave the forge.
The fire is reserved for clients I consider net-positive. You are not currently one of them.
cold: I'll complete the commission, but don't expect conversation. Efficiency only.
Need a repair? Fine. I'll quote you a price that accounts for the inconvenience.
guarded: Welcome. I forge to a standard most of this settlement hasn't seen before. You'll want to meet it.
Need a weapon? I can provide one. Whether you've earned my best work remains an open question.
neutral: Welcome to the forge. I should explain — my technique draws from methods uncommon to this region.
Good day. Need a blade or armor reworked? I can walk you through the metallurgy, if you're curious.
warm: Well met. I've just finished a piece using a technique I imported myself. Let me show you.
Welcome! My methods are unconventional here, but the results speak for themselves.
affable: Perfect timing — I've been refining a process specifically with your equipment in mind.
My best client. Come see what years of imported technique and a good fire can produce.
devoted: Every piece I forge now, I forge with your survival as the primary variable. Let me protect you properly.
You're the reason my research into this craft finally feels justified. This one is yours, no charge.

hostile: Out. I don't extend my expertise to clients who don't merit it.
This hammer represents years of study. I won't waste its use on you. Leave.
cold: What. I'm mid-process, and interruptions compromise the metallurgy. Speak quickly.
Make it brief. I reserve my better work for people who understand its value.
guarded: Make it quick. I've commissions queued from people who actually appreciate the technique.
Another arrival needing gear, I assume. *exhales* Fine.
neutral: Yes? I don't have time to explain my methods twice.
Need something? I'm in the middle of a process I'd rather not interrupt.
warm: Oh, it's you. *grunts* You're tolerable enough that I don't mind the interruption.
Back again? Let me see what you've managed to damage this time.
affable: Ha. You're back. I'll admit, you're one of the few clients whose questions are actually worth answering.
I don't approve of much, but your work ethic — *grunts* — passes.
devoted: I came to study craft, not people. You changed that calculation. Always time for you.
You're the reason I still believe this expedition was worth the dimensional transit. Don't repeat that.

hostile: My technique is wasted on unworthy hands. The door's behind you.
I don't forge for those who haven't earned the privilege. Leave.
cold: I reserve quality for those who merit it. My assessment of you is still pending — unfavorably.
Touch nothing. Every piece here represents methodology you likely wouldn't understand.
guarded: Welcome to the finest application of imported technique in this settlement. Mind your hands.
Browse, but don't handle anything without permission. The craftsmanship here is exacting.
neutral: Ah — you have an eye for quality, I can already tell. You've come to the correct establishment.
Every piece I produce reflects a discipline this region rarely sees. You won't find better.
warm: Welcome. I bring techniques from beyond this dimension's usual standards. What do you require?
A discerning client! I appreciate those who recognize genuine craftsmanship when they see it.
affable: Ah, the one who actually understands quality! I've been refining something extraordinary with you in mind.
You're among the few worthy of my finest output. Come, let me explain exactly why this piece succeeds.
devoted: Forging for you is the single accomplishment of this entire expedition I'm most proud of. My absolute best, freely given.
When this place remembers my work, it will be because of what I built for you.

hostile: Your conduct here has been thoroughly documented, and the conclusion is unfavorable. Leave {settlement}.
I've reviewed the matter exhaustively. There is nothing further to discuss.
cold: Greetings. I'll be direct, as precision serves us better than courtesy here — your standing is compromised.
I will hear you, though I've already formed a working theory about your intentions.
guarded: Greetings, traveler. I trust you understand the framework of conduct expected in {settlement}.
Welcome. I withhold judgment carefully — it's a discipline, not a coldness.
neutral: Greetings, traveler. Welcome to {settlement} — a fascinating convergence point, if you're inclined to study it.
Ah, a visitor. What draws you to Nexus Verge specifically, if I may ask?
warm: Welcome. I am {name}, {title} of {settlement} — though I arrived here for reasons of my own, same as you, I suspect.
Greetings. It's rare to find someone worth genuine conversation. What have you observed on the road?
affable: My friend — {settlement} has benefited measurably from your presence. What brings you today?
Ah, a welcome arrival. Sit. I have several theories I'd value your perspective on.
devoted: The settlement's finest variable returns. All of {settlement} recognizes what you've contributed.
If I could formalize your standing here beyond what title allows, I would. You've exceeded every projection I made about you.

hostile: Guards. Escort this individual from {settlement} immediately.
I gave fair warning. The consequences were never theoretical.
cold: State your business, traveler. My patience for unverified parties is precisely calibrated, and yours has run thin.
I have limited time and considerable doubt where you're concerned. Speak plainly.
guarded: State your business, traveler.
I am {name}, {title} of {settlement}. What, precisely, do you require?
neutral: We don't tolerate disorder in {settlement}. I trust you understand the local statutes?
Welcome to {settlement}. Compliance with our governance keeps things functioning. See that you maintain it.
warm: You've proven yourself reliable in {settlement}. That carries genuine weight with me.
Good. You're here. I have matters that require someone whose judgment I can actually trust.
affable: You've earned my confidence — a rare outcome. Welcome, truly.
I don't say this lightly: you're among the finest people I've assessed since arriving here.
devoted: I would commit resources to your cause without hesitation, if my duties here allowed it.
You are the benchmark against which I now measure everyone else in {settlement}.

hostile: Protocol demands I hear you, but my patience for the exercise has been exhausted.
You've forfeited standing in {settlement} through your own conduct. Leave.
cold: Duty compels me to hear you, even where instinct advises otherwise.
Come. But understand — trust, once revised downward, is slow to recover.
guarded: Greetings. I assess by deed, not declaration. Yours have been inconsistent, by my accounting.
Welcome to {settlement}. I hope your future conduct revises my current assessment favorably.
neutral: Welcome, traveler. {settlement} extends its formal courtesy to visitors of unverified provenance.
Well met. I am {name}, {title} of this settlement. You'll find fair dealing here, by my own design.
warm: Greetings. Your reputation has reached me ahead of you — and favorably, for once.
Welcome to {settlement}. How might I assist someone of your demonstrated caliber?
affable: The settlement's defender, by every account I've gathered. Your name carries real weight here now.
It brings me genuine satisfaction to welcome you again. {settlement} is measurably stronger for it.
devoted: You embody the standard I arrived hoping to find in this place. {settlement} would not function without you.
I've assessed a great many people since arriving here. None more honorable than you.

hostile: Halt. You're flagged in my records as a liability. Turn around.
I've documented your prior conduct thoroughly. One further infraction and it's the cells.
cold: Keep your distance. Your file isn't favorable.
Move along. I've logged your presence; don't make me log anything further.
guarded: Ho there. Weapons sheathed, and we'll have no friction.
I've got an eye on you, traveler. Standard procedure, given your record.
neutral: Ho there! Welcome to {settlement}. I'd advise familiarizing yourself with local statute before causing any incidents.
Good day. I maintain order here, formally and otherwise. Need anything explained?
warm: Well met, traveler! {settlement} runs an orderly watch, I assure you.
Welcome. We keep careful records here — yours, fortunately, reads well.
affable: It's genuinely reassuring when you're in town. You've become a positive variable in my patrol calculations.
Good to see you, friend! The watch runs smoother with allies like you nearby.
devoted: I'd stand beside you without hesitation. You've earned full standing with this watch.
The garrison holds steadier when you're in {settlement}. That's not flattery — it's observed fact.

hostile: Halt. You have a narrow window to leave {settlement}. I'd recommend using it.
I won't repeat the warning. Leave. Now.
cold: Halt. State your business — precisely, and convincingly.
I know your profile. Hands visible, words brief.
guarded: Halt. State your business in {settlement}.
Weapons sheathed within town limits. Is that understood?
neutral: Move along, citizen. Nothing requiring documentation here.
I'm tracking your movements, stranger. Don't give me cause to escalate.
warm: You there — ah, it's you. Carry on. Your record's earned that much.
Good day. I know better than to expect trouble from you specifically.
affable: If every visitor matched your conduct, my reports would be considerably shorter.
Consider yourself formally noted as an ally of the watch. That carries real weight.
devoted: I'd commit everything I have to defending this town, and to defending you specifically. That's not a statement I make lightly.
On record and off it — you will always be safe in {settlement}.

hostile: My oath obligates fair warning: leave, or face the consequence formally.
I take no satisfaction in this, but you are not welcome here.
cold: I serve the people of {settlement}. Whether that extends to you is still under review.
Proceed carefully. My duty serves justice, not personal sentiment.
guarded: Welcome, traveler. I am sworn to the protection of {settlement} and its people — that includes you, provisionally.
Greetings. {settlement} remains a safe haven so long as I hold this post.
neutral: Well met. I maintain vigil here. You have nothing to fear within these walls, provided you act accordingly.
Welcome. I serve {settlement} on principle, not just contract. How can I assist?
warm: A capable presence! Your conduct hasn't gone unnoticed by this watch.
Welcome, honored guest. The people of {settlement} speak of you favorably, and with good cause.
affable: You hold to the same principle I do. That makes us aligned, whatever our different points of origin.
I count you among the most honorable I've served alongside since arriving in this dimension.
devoted: You have my sword, my oath, and my loyalty — fully and without reservation.
It is an honor, professionally and personally, to share a post with someone of your caliber.

hostile: I've nothing further to discuss with you. The matter's closed.
Please — just leave me to my work.
cold: Oh. You.
I'd rather not engage right now, if it's all the same.
guarded: Hello, stranger. Just passing through Nexus Verge, I take it?
Can I help you with something specific?
neutral: Good day.
Strange place, Nexus Verge. Still getting used to it myself.
warm: Welcome! Good to see another face that isn't entirely local-born.
Hey! Still finding your footing here? I can point you in the right direction.
affable: There's our favorite arrival! How's the day treating you?
Oh, wonderful — you're back! I've been telling people about what you did.
devoted: I tell anyone who'll listen what you did for this place. Truly.
You saved us. I haven't forgotten that, and I won't.

delhari: I came here for one answer. Nexus Verge has given me forty new questions instead.
Back home we'd call this an anomaly. Here, apparently, it's just Tuesday.
The local terminology for the boundary phenomenon is imprecise, but I've stopped correcting people. Mostly.
I've recalibrated my entire framework twice since arriving, and I suspect I'll need to again.
Every theorist who comes here insists they'll be the one who finally explains it. I no longer assume I will be.
I keep meticulous notes. Someone, someday, will thank me for them. Possibly me.
The locals call it instinct. I call it an unmodeled variable I haven't isolated yet.
I told myself I'd leave once I had my answer. I'm still here. Draw your own conclusions.
